journey.name: Lift: a barbell and its plates
journey.description: Set a 20 kg bar under Your equipment, follow Barbell 5×5, log day 1's first back squat on the empty bar, then a power clean at 60 kg off the plan with its plates a side checked, and finish. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Tap the "Lift" tab, then the "Your equipment and records" button
Verify that "Your bar" offers "None" selected, "10 kg", "15 kg" and "20 kg", above "Your bands"
Tap "20 kg" under "Your bar", then go back
Tap "Follow a program"
Scroll to the "Barbell" group and verify it lists "Olympic foundations" and "Barbell 5×5"
Tap "Barbell 5×5", then "Follow this program"
Verify that Lift shows "Day 1 of 36 · week 1", "Back squat" "5 × 5" with "20 kg", "Bench press", "Barbell row", and "Start day 1"
Tap "Start day 1"
Verify that the session shows "Up next · 1 of 15 sets", "Back squat" and "20 kg × 5"
Tap "Log it"
Verify that the session lists "Back squat" with a set "20 kg × 5", "Moved" at "100 kg", and "Up next · 2 of 15 sets"
Tap "Log set", then "Change", and type "power clean" into "Search exercises"
Tap "Power clean"
Verify that the exercise card reads "Power clean" over "Barbell · Reps · Full body", "On the bar" reads "20 kg", and "20 kg bar, empty" is shown under it
Tap "+" beside "20 kg" 16 times
Verify that "On the bar" reads "60 kg" and "20 kg bar · 20 a side" is shown
Tap "+" once more
Verify that it reads "62.5 kg" and "20 kg bar · 20 + 1.25 a side"
Tap "Log set" at the bottom of the sheet
Verify that the session shows "Power clean" with a set "62.5 kg × 10", and "Moved" reads "725 kg"
Tap "Finish"
Verify that the summary lists "Back squat" with "Heaviest 20 kg × 5" and "Power clean" with "Heaviest 62.5 kg × 10" under "New records"
Tap "Done"
Verify that Lift shows "Day 2 of 36 · week 1" with "Back squat", "Overhead press" and "Barbell deadlift"
